name: Takeshiba
tagline: Tokyo in 12 minutes and Toranomon in 12 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥170,000 to ¥180,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 19 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 25 minutes to Shibuya and 16 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. The station stands 2.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 2.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 0 m to 4 m, a difference of 4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 4 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 4 pharmacies. The nearest facility recorded as a hospital is 芝公園かみやまクリニック, about 925 m from the station. The next nearest is 港勤労者医療協会芝病院, about 1102 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
congestion: Yurikamome runs at 92% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 汐留→竹芝, which includes this station. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥170,000 to ¥180,000, 1K ¥150,000 to ¥160,000, 1LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000 and 2LDK ¥500,000 to ¥510,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Hamamatsucho, but Takeshiba is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.
neighbours.note: 479 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 7 minutes sooner than Takeshiba. One-room rents run about ¥29,000 lower.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Hinode, but Takeshiba is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: 613 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Takeshiba. One-room rents run about ¥30,000 lower.

People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: The 首都高速1号羽田線 viaduct runs 160 m away. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
新橋日の出ふ頭線 (a main road) runs 4 m away. Morning and evening, the cars are audible indoors

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 3 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 9 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Yurikamome serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
